description: Enjoy our Sunset Villa at Casa Esmeralda!Relax in your private rooftop hot tub after a day at the beach. Casa Esmeralda Sunset Villa is just a short walk from Balneario Beach, downtown Rincon, restaurants, cafes and nightlife. Sunset Villa is the perfect home base for exploring everything Rincón has to offer.Walk to:• Balneario Beach (2 minutes)• Downtown Rincón (10 minutes)• Restaurants• Cafés• Local bakery• Pharmacy• Convenience storesFor your beach days, we provide beach chairs, beach towels, an umbrella, and a beach cart, so you can travel light and enjoy the coast without packing extra gear.The fully equipped kitchen has everything you need to prepare meals, from a quick breakfast before the beach to a family dinner after a day of exploring.Traveling with a larger group? description: Discover the essence of Rincón in our newly renovated home, where breathtaking mountain views await from the balcony. Located just a short drive from pristine beaches and the lively town square, this inviting retreat offers the ideal fusion of relaxation and adventure for families and friends eager to explore the beauty of Puerto Rico.The spaceExperience the epitome of comfort and convenience in this thoughtfully renovated haven. Immerse yourself in the allure of modern living with air conditioning in every room, supplemented by a sustainable solar power backup system. Stay connected with high-speed WIFI, revel in the ease of laundry with a washer/dryer, and unwind with Smart TVs and ceiling fans in each space. Indulge in panoramic mountain vistas from the expansive wrap-around balcony and outdoor entertaining area, set amidst a generously-sized backyard perfect for gatherings with loved ones. Enjoy the best of both worlds with stunning mountain views sans the mountain drive,Guest accessjust a swift 5-minute journey to world-renowned surf beaches, Rincon Square, and a plethora of amenities. Convenience reigns supreme with nearby essentials including a gas station, pharmacy, bakery, and restaurants, all within walking distance.Other things to noteThere is plenty of yard to enjoy and also a few fruit trees.we don’t provide snorkeling gear.
